name: Sakagami Mamoru
source: Protagonist of the story and university student. He lives alone after his parents traveled abroad for works. He has secret feeling for the next-door housewife Chihaya and always looks after her daughter Hina. A kind and gentle young man but becoming emotional when his beloved people are hurt.
